5e0c95c3ce8fd16714f5892795ca8b6e.overview: After young Mary Gibson discovers that her older sister Jacqueline has disappeared, she leaves her boarding school and heads to New York City to track down her sibling. But Mary gets drawn deeper into the mystery.
5e0c95c3ce8fd16714f5892795ca8b6e.tagline: Weird pagan rites in secret dens of exotic mystery! Beauty enslaved to a creed of Evil! Loveliness at bay behind a mask of Terror... See the strangest thrills on record!

5e266fe3b576306212ac8bd669d1d51e.overview: Vietnam vet Jon Rubin returns to New York and rents a rundown flat in Greenwich Village. It is in this flat that he begins to film, 'Peeping Tom' style, the people in the apartment across the street. His obsession with making films leads him to fall in with a radical 'Black Power' group, which in turn leads him to carry out a bizarre act of urban terrorism.
5e266fe3b576306212ac8bd669d1d51e.tagline: God bless our humble upper-middle-class high-rise co-op and keep it free from smut peddlers, militants, urban guerrillas and Greenwich Village liberals.

5e39bee35e1fc055cf00d1b98008925c.overview: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.
5e39bee35e1fc055cf00d1b98008925c.tagline: One of the most legendary directors of our time takes you on an extraordinary adventure.

5e3d10d0de5e931e61671f7821aedef1.overview: Mogador, Morocco. Late 1920s. A complex romance develops between a womanizing Legionnaire and a disillusioned Parisian cabaret singer.
5e3d10d0de5e931e61671f7821aedef1.tagline: Who is this woman who scorns a hundred men...to give her love to a Devil-May-Care Soldier?

5e5086d3589b738c2b9fa28148221432.overview: Sutter, a popular party animal, unexpectedly meets the introverted Aimee after waking up on a stranger's lawn. As Sutter deals with the problems in his life and Aimee plans for her future beyond school, an unexpected romance blossoms between them.
5e5086d3589b738c2b9fa28148221432.tagline: Hits You Like A Shot In The Heart.

5e55f2162693d2c6c8eddb13312523a6.overview: A tramp falls in love with a beautiful blind flower girl. His on-and-off friendship with a wealthy man allows him to be the girl's benefactor and suitor.

5e9e3d7b06f801df8b238fa554f9a13e.overview: After returning to San Francisco, Nick and Nora Charles are drawn into the disappearance of Nora’s cousin’s husband. When he is found murdered, suspicion falls on the troubled family, and Nick reluctantly resumes his detective work. With Nora eagerly at his side, the pair follows a trail of jealousy, blackmail, secret relationships, and long-buried family scandals.
5e9e3d7b06f801df8b238fa554f9a13e.tagline: Continuing the fun in their NEW hit!

5ea6fcf9e9dfd9af7866f7dd31fefbd6.overview: When the first manned mission to Mars meets with a catastrophic and mysterious disaster after reporting an unidentified structure, a rescue mission is launched to investigate the tragedy and bring back any survivors.
5ea6fcf9e9dfd9af7866f7dd31fefbd6.tagline: For centuries we've been looking for the origin of life on earth. We've been looking on the wrong planet.

5eaaab69128946f309e3974000b230fc.overview: Cadaverous scream legend the Crypt Keeper is your macabre host for these forays of fright and fun based on the classic E.C. Comics tales from back in the day. So shamble up to the bar and pick your poison. Will it be an insane Santa on a personal slay ride? Honeymooners out to fulfill the "til death do we part" vow ASAP?

5ee3b7aa8e312362212f54cc1fe31c90.overview: Uncouth, loud-mouth junkyard tycoon Harry Brock descends upon Washington D.C. to buy himself a congressman or two, bringing with him his mistress, ex-showgirl Billie Dawn.

5eec486632c33256f1a19277ba8dd89b.overview: There is a global gender war between men and women. A teenage girl tries to escape this reality and arrives at a hidden place where a strange unicorn lives with a family: sister, brother, many children and an old, bedridden woman who stays in contact with the world through her radio.

5eff66c93a96fb2f9cccc5d12efdf5e0.overview: When his best friend and podcast co-host goes missing in the backwoods of Canada, a young guy joins forces with his friend's girlfriend to search for him.
